results.title: Oriental Interest expands income stream with RM280mil acquisitions
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Oriental Interest Bhd (OIB) has proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in Chin Hin (Jitra) Sdn Bhd (CHJSB) and CHJ Motor Holdings Sdn Bhd (CMHSB) for RM280mil as it aims to expand its business portfolio.

results.title: Ghana: Govt Targets Gh¢30bn Sinking Fund to Meet DDEP Obligations
results.description: [Ghanaian Times] The Government has projected to accumulate GH¢30 billion in the Sinking Fund by the end of this year as part of efforts to prepare for the repayment of obligations under the Domestic Debt Exchange Programme (DDEP), with the first major maturity falling due in February 2027.

results.title: China chipmaker CXMT's shares surge 470% in Shanghai trading debut
results.description: Shares of CXMT Corp surged nearly 470 percent at their Shanghai debut on Monday after Asia's biggest IPO this year, catapulting the chipmaker to the top of China's stock market by valuation despite a recent selloff in global tech stocks.
